summary: Keep generated Bitcoin RPC passwords out of standalone command output
details: The standalone rpcauth generator now writes generated client credentials directly into an existing private node.env and prints only non-secret file metadata.
The operation rejects symlinked or group/world-readable node environments, duplicate or missing credential fields, mismatched rpcauth paths, and concurrent node.env changes.
A node.env update failure removes the newly created rpcauth file so operators do not inherit a partially installed credential pair.
operator_actions: Update any direct generate_bitcoin_rpcauth.py invocation to pass the private node.env through --node-env; the supported run_testnet_bitcoin.sh wrapper already does this.
